questions.stem: What two types of monomers are needed to make a polyester?

options.text: A diamine and a dicarboxylic acid
A diol and a dicarboxylic acid

questions.explanation: A polyester is formed from a diol (molecule with two -OH groups) and a dicarboxylic acid (molecule with two -COOH groups). The -OH and -COOH groups react to form ester links (-COO-), with water released as a by-product at each link.
